name: Inamoto Miyu
source:
A third-year student. The vice captain of the track and field team.

Half of a veteran yuri couple. A cool and collected realist. Demands a cautious relationship, fearing her strict parents would separate them if they found out. She loves Matsuri so much she's decided she'd die if they couldn't be together.

The type who wants to marry her lover.

Strength: Excels at both sports and studies
Weakness: Not good with cats
Hobby: Making sweets
Skills: Physical conditioning, creating training programs

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
